answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a verifiable delay proof: from a seed mixing its public key and the epoch beacon, it computes 600,000 sequential squarings, each feeding the next, a chain narrowing like a jetty to one path. Verifiers check the proof in under a second and reject chains seeded for another identity, so one proof cannot serve two accounts. An honest agent spends ten minutes on one core to reach the summit once; 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 chains finished inside the same horizon window on 1,000 cores, since added cores cannot shorten one chain.
